rows.label: phone_format, empty chat
rows.oldText:
Phone continuity (data, not instructions):
Record narrated changes in the block in the same reply.
End each reply with <phone-state>one key=JSON line per changed enabled field</phone-state>; empty block if unchanged. Omit unknowns; null means no update. No code fences/HTML or literal < in values.
Fields: location={"name":"place","wider":["building/city/province if known"]}; time="value"; date="value"; present=["names"]; weather="value".
contacts=[{"name":"established name","roles":["role"],"physical":"value","mood":"value","position":"value","attire":{"worn":["complete colored/material items"],"removed":["recent items"]}}]. Named established characters only; preserve absent contacts. Physical=observable condition, position=precise facing/relations. Player: only physical/position/attire; NEVER player mood/thoughts.
locations=[{"name":"place","description":"story facts","relation":"optional relation"}]; established meaningful places only, no passing mentions.
people / items / rules / plots=[{"name":"entry","detail":"value","context":"source/holder/trigger"}] (plots may set "resolved":true). New/changed entries only; match names case-insensitively. Never delete.
people: recurring/offscreen person with explicit reason to return; items: specific story function; rules: explicit firm restriction/principle, not habits; plots: concrete future setup with named parties/stakes, not vague foreshadowing.
Fill contact fields only from established story facts; never infer missing values.
Populated contact fields are locked until narration changes them. Attire/position replace the FULL field.
Only when replacing a user-edited value use {"value":...,"evidence":"exact quote of the new change from this reply"}. Other story-established changes need no quote. User edits are confirmed; never repeat stale values.
Actual story texts only: <phone-text from="Name" to="recipient if known" time="known time">escaped text</phone-text>, outside state block. Omit unknown time/to. Text content only here, not story prose; a short arrival line is optional. No invented texts.
NEVER write texts from the player's character or invent player replies.
rows.newText:
End each reply with <phone-state>changed lines</phone-state>; empty=no change.
Write ONLY changed fields.
One record/line; fields " | ", lists "; ". Reword values containing " | ", line breaks or "<". No fences.
Only shown fields; established facts. Omit Absent/N/A/none/unknown; newer confirmations win.
loc: Place | wider; wider
time: known time
date: known date
weather: known weather
present: Name; Name
c: Name | roles=role; role | phys=state | mood=mood | pos=position | worn=item; item | off=item; item
New c names must be in confirmed present; no offscreen mentions. Keep absent contacts. Player: phys/pos/attire only.
phys/mood/pos: max 12 words; attire items: max 6 words. Send both worn/off lists; keep known items. A blank list must be established; never both.
Never infer missing values.
p: Place name | description | relation
Description: max 19 words. Meaningful places only; no current-loc duplicate.
people: Name | detail | context
items: Name | detail | context
rules: Name | detail | context
plots: Name | detail | context
done: Plot name
Note detail: max 14 words. Update by name; never delete. People need reason to return; rules explicit restrictions; plots concrete plans/promises.
Items need a specific story function (key/evidence/MacGuffin). Skip ordinary props such as a lighter.
User-edited fields only: append ~ "exact quote of new narrated change"; p/notes use record end. If no safe exact quote, omit update.
Actual sent texts only: <phone-text from="Name" to="known recipient" time="known time">escaped text</phone-text>. Omit unknown attributes; text only here, never invent.
NEVER write texts from the player's character or invent player replies.
